svg.title: Folio after the ruled migration
svg.desc: Folio as docs/ARCHITECTURE.md rules it to become: the lane moves of §5.4 steps 2 to 5 with their versions, the three owners of §4.1, bt-workbench and the outward adapters of §12, and the crate changes of §3.2. Anything the file leaves open is marked not ruled.
svg.text: Folio after the ruled migration — what docs/ARCHITECTURE.md rules, and nothing more
The lanes of §5.4 steps 2–5, the three owners of §4.1, and §12. A badge is the version the file rules; “not ruled” is what it leaves open. A lane is a logical owner, not one thread per row (§5.1).
each one exits; none holds a window
hands its argv to the running one:
